## What changed?

Describe the change and why you made it. Link the issue or discussion if there is one.

## Tests run

List the commands you ran and their results. Include the quick sweep for code changes.

## Docs updated

Link the pages you changed, or explain why no documentation change is needed. If a Chinese counterpart exists for a changed English page, update it too.

## Style rules

Confirm that changed Python files pass Ruff. Follow the [documentation style rules](https://github.com/mkj69/opulse/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#documentation): use concrete claims, avoid dashes in prose and explain each example in one plain sentence.
